title: Config-driven ingestion - one TOML per lane, thin strategies, one runner, cron runtime, LayerService serving
description: Cap legacy soil first (G0: 33 logical requests per run, probe-gated frontier, probe faults exit 0, requests/weighted calls/HTTP attempts reported) before the paid Open-Meteo key is set; then an observability and soft-failure wave (Wave O, GL-1..GL-5 small pushes before Phase 1: one redacted logging contract, metered and turn-attributed upstream sends, a read-only source-usage report, failures recorded on incident rows without failing a tick or another lane; self-probing holds, the paid Open-Meteo cap and a monthly usage receipt at G1); then replace per-lane forward modules and scattered lane facts with typed lane TOML (shipped by the Dockerfile and digested by the receipt), a strategy Protocol in pipeline/runner/contract.py resolved by import-path convention and one shared runner with a probe-gated forward fan-out and per-mode per-turn caps; unify forward and gap-fill; transforms as persisted input-driven lanes; a session-per-lane work-queue executor with a split breaker (incident rows only); a LayerService registry over parquet_ops via sanic-ext DI; new streams registered through a TOML-checked mirror; climate meteorology re-sourced to Open-Meteo ERA5 (explicit nodes on the manifest's 0.25 deg analysis lattice) plus an IFS tail ending yesterday UTC, solar on NASA POWER UTC re-gridded plus an IFS tail; water gauges moved early to USGS daily values with history to 1990-09-30; the remaining lanes cut over by a reviewed swarm; per-lane production QA and validation; then the legacy path retired by a dedicated supersession cleanup lane that fires only on verified readiness (quarantine, observe, delete code; no data deleted).
